description: Charge comparison of mite CBM14 domains against the chitin-binding CBM14 tachycitin, and exposed acidic/basic/aromatic surface composition of Der p 23 in 4ZCE
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
# ===========================================================================
# PROVENANCE: net charge / isoelectric point of mite CBM14 domains vs the
# chitin-binding reference CBM14 (tachycitin), and the exposed acidic surface
# of Der p 23 measured on 4ZCE chain A.
# ===========================================================================
def up_seq(acc):
    r=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60)
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])
lep=up_seq("Q1M2L5"); dp15=up_seq("Q4JK70")
DOM={
 'Der p 23 core 43-90'   : up_seq("L7N6F8")[42:],
 'Der f 23 core'         : up_seq("A0A088SAW7")[43:],
 'Blo t 12 CBM14'        : up_seq("Q17282")[94:],
 'Lep d 12 CBM14'        : lep[93:],
 'Der p 18 CBM14'        : up_seq("Q4JK71")[406:],
 'Der p 15 CBM14'        : dp15[475:],
 'tachycitin (chitin+)'  : up_seq("P82107"),
 'Der p 23 full mature'  : up_seq("L7N6F8")[21:],
}
pKa={'D':3.65,'E':4.25,'C':8.18,'Y':10.07,'H':6.00,'K':10.53,'R':12.48}
def charge(s,pH):
    q=1/(1+10**(pH-8.2))-1/(1+10**(3.65-pH))   # termini
    for a in s:
        if a in 'KRH': q+= 1/(1+10**(pH-pKa[a]))
        elif a in 'DECY': q-= 1/(1+10**(pKa[a]-pH))
    return q
def pI(s):
    lo,hi=0.,14.
    for _ in range(60):
        mid=(lo+hi)/2
        if charge(s,mid)>0: lo=mid
        else: hi=mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
rows=[]
for k,s in DOM.items():
    rows.append(dict(domain=k,len=len(s),
        D_E=sum(c in 'DE' for c in s), K_R=sum(c in 'KR' for c in s),
        net_q_pH7=round(charge(s,7.0),2), pI=round(pI(s),2),
        arom_FWY=sum(c in 'FWY' for c in s)))
t=pd.DataFrame(rows); print(t.to_string(index=False))

# exposed acidic surface on 4ZCE chain A
RAD={'C':1.70,'N':1.55,'O':1.52,'S':1.80}
pdb=requests.get("https://files.rcsb.org/download/4ZCE.pdb",timeout=120).text
at=[]
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if not l.startswith("ATOM") or l[21]!='A' or l[16] not in (" ","A"): continue
    el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0]).upper()
    if el in ("H","D"): continue
    at.append((l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),el,
               (float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]))))
x=np.array([a[4] for a in at]); r=np.array([RAD.get(a[3],1.8) for a in at])+1.4
n=960; i=np.arange(n)+0.5; ph=np.arccos(1-2*i/n); th=np.pi*(1+5**0.5)*i
sp=np.c_[np.cos(th)*np.sin(ph),np.sin(th)*np.sin(ph),np.cos(ph)]
d=np.linalg.norm(x[:,None]-x[None],axis=-1); S=np.zeros(len(at))
for k in range(len(at)):
    nb=np.where((d[k]<r[k]+r)&(np.arange(len(at))!=k))[0]; pts=x[k]+r[k]*sp
    acc=(np.linalg.norm(pts[:,None]-x[nb][None],axis=-1)>=r[nb][None]).all(1) if len(nb) else np.ones(n,bool)
    S[k]=4*np.pi*r[k]**2*acc.mean()
tot=S.sum()
def grp(f): return sum(s for a,s in zip(at,S) if f(a))
acid = grp(lambda a: a[1] in ('ASP','GLU') and a[0] in ('OD1','OD2','CG','OE1','OE2','CD'))
basic= grp(lambda a: a[1] in ('LYS','ARG') and a[0] in ('NZ','CE','NE','CZ','NH1','NH2'))
arom = grp(lambda a: a[1] in ('PHE','TYR','TRP') and a[0] in
          ('CG','CD1','CD2','CE1','CE2','CZ','CE3','CZ2','CZ3','CH2','NE1'))
print(f"\n4ZCE chain A total heavy-atom SASA = {tot:.0f} A^2")
print(f"  carboxylate (Asp/Glu side-chain tip) SASA = {acid:.0f} A^2  ({acid/tot*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  Lys/Arg side-chain tip SASA              = {basic:.0f} A^2  ({basic/tot*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  aromatic ring SASA                        = {arom:.0f} A^2  ({arom/tot*100:.1f}%)")
print(f"  carboxylate : ammonium/guanidinium ratio  = {acid/basic:.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
lab=list(t.domain); yq=t.net_q_pH7.values
c=['#1f77b4']*len(lab); c[lab.index('tachycitin (chitin+)')]='#2ca02c'
ax[0].barh(range(len(lab)),yq,color=c); ax[0].axvline(0,c='k',lw=0.8)
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(lab))); ax[0].set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel('net charge at pH 7.0'); ax[0].set_title('Mite CBM14 domains are acidic;\nthe chitin-binding reference tachycitin is basic')
for i2,v in enumerate(yq): ax[0].text(v+(0.2 if v>0 else -0.2),i2,f"{v:+.1f} (pI {t.pI[i2]:.1f})",
                                      va='center',ha='left' if v>0 else 'right',fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_xlim(min(yq)-4,max(yq)+4)
ax[1].bar(['carboxylate\n(Asp/Glu)','Lys/Arg\ntips','aromatic\nrings'],[acid,basic,arom],
          color=['#d62728','#1f77b4','#ff7f0e'])
ax[1].set_ylabel('solvent accessible surface (A$^2$)')
ax[1].set_title('Der p 23 exposed surface composition, 4ZCE chain A\n(total %.0f A$^2$)'%tot)
for i2,v in enumerate([acid,basic,arom]): ax[1].text(i2,v+8,f"{v:.0f}\n{v/tot*100:.1f}%",ha='center',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
